title: NetworkPostureView
description: Aggregate network posture computed from live PeerStatus rows and stewarded_nodes projection. Source of truth: computed per-request (operational Category C); PeerStatus DHT entries in infrastructure DNA back the peer counts. No persistence, no new entry type.

totalPeers.description: Distinct peers with a PeerStatus row.

activePeers.description: Peers currently online or degraded but responding.

stalePeers.description: Peers whose last update is older than 120 s.

alwaysOnPeers.description: Peers in the general pool + currently active.

householdsReciprocating.description: Distinct households with at least one active peer.

computeAvailable.description: At least one active peer accepts stewardship reserves.

storagePressure.description: Aggregate shard-locations pressure (0-1). Placeholder until shard_locations is populated.
